criteria.observation: An ordinary enabled root checkbox click changed the toolbar to 1 selected and established the subsequent range anchor.
Shift+click selected four eligible roots across two disabled protected roots, then a second Shift+click deselected the same eligible range; neither protected root became checked.
After collapsing the anchor's project, Shift+click selected only the clicked visible root and established a safe new anchor.
Clear followed by Shift+click selected one root, and All followed by Shift+click changed only the clicked root, demonstrating both controls reset the anchor.

Protected checkboxes stayed disabled with reasons, enabled checkboxes exposed Shift range help, project ordering and selected counts remained stable, and a three-root delete preview was cancelled with zero deletions.

notes: Observable outcome QA only; separate from code review.
